title: Thin-layer chromatography and Rf values
caption: Components separate by how strongly they are held by the stationary phase and carried by the mobile phase. Rf is the distance a spot moved divided by the distance the solvent front moved, always between 0 and 1, and characteristic for a substance under stated conditions. Pigment values here are illustrative.
alt: A thin-layer plate with the origin at the bottom and a solvent front 80 millimetres above it, with three pigment spots at 72, 40 and 32 millimetres, giving Rf values of 0.90, 0.50 and 0.40.
description: The Rf value depends on the solvent and the plate, so conditions must be stated.
